name: VaultGlass
subtitle: Receipts, warranties & items
purpose: VaultGlass helps individuals keep receipts, item details, estimated warranty dates and home inventory in one place.
audience: People managing personal purchases and household inventory.
features: Import receipts from photos, document scans, PDFs or text. Review and correct extracted facts.
Track estimated return and warranty dates, attach evidence and prepare claim drafts.
Filter a home inventory by property and room, then export an insurance valuation PDF.
limits: Coverage and depreciation are estimates. Always check merchant, manufacturer, card-provider and insurer terms.
promotionalText: VaultGlass helps individuals keep receipts, item details, estimated warranty dates and home inventory in one place.
description:
VaultGlass helps individuals keep receipts, item details, estimated warranty dates and home inventory in one place.

Import receipts from photos, document scans, PDFs or text. Review and correct extracted facts.

Track estimated return and warranty dates, attach evidence and prepare claim drafts.

Filter a home inventory by property and room, then export an insurance valuation PDF.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document recognition and analysis run on device. Compatible devices may use Apple’s on-device Foundation Models; deterministic local extraction is available when the model is unavailable. Optional synchronization uses your private iCloud container. No account registration or third-party AI key is required.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five completed on-device AI actions per app. Pro unlocks additional AI actions through a monthly or annual subscription, or a separate lifetime purchase. Prices and eligibility are shown by the App Store. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

Coverage and depreciation are estimates. Always check merchant, manufacturer, card-provider and insurer terms.

name: BioPulse Local
subtitle: Lab history and visit prep
purpose: BioPulse Local helps adults organize lab reports, compare saved biomarker measurements and prepare questions for clinician visits.
audience: Adults who want a personal lab history and educational visit-preparation tools.
features: Import a lab PDF or document photo and verify the extracted values and units.
Compare biomarker history with optional read-only Apple Health trends and dated lifestyle notes.
Prepare clinician questions, export a doctor brief and record laboratory preparation tasks.
limits: Educational organization and estimates only. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent disease. Reference intervals are illustrative, not individualized clinical thresholds. Follow your clinician and laboratory instructions. PhenoAge is an estimate, not a clinical assessment.

name: ClauseShield
subtitle: Contract review and reply
purpose: ClauseShield helps individuals inspect agreements, understand flagged wording and prepare proposed changes for discussion.
audience: Freelancers, creators, tenants and individuals preparing to discuss an agreement.
features: Import an agreement as PDF, text or scanned pages and choose a role and category.
Review source quotes, screening flags and missing-protection checks; save or dismiss suggested replacements.
Compare paragraph versions and export a negotiation draft or redline comparison memo.
limits: Screening and drafting assistance only. It is not legal advice or a completeness, enforceability or outcome guarantee. A qualified lawyer should assess the final agreement.
